verdict.rationale: Factory documents end-to-end feature delegation. You can assign a Linear or Jira issue to have Droid "investigate, implement, and test the work," then review the diff and merge from the App or terminal. Missions add structured planning of features, milestones and success criteria for larger multi-feature work. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Droid authors new test suites rather than only running or validating tests, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end feature delivery.
